description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to unit conversions within a schema, including methods for generating a graph representation and filtering normalized and transitive conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::UnitConversion
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling unit conversion records, providing methods for graph conversion and filtering based on normalization and transitivity.

methods.name: as_graph
methods.description: Creates and returns a UnitConversionGraph object based on the current ResultSet.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Returns a filtered ResultSet where unit1_id is less than unit2_id, indicating normalized conversions.

methods.name: not_normalized
methods.description: Returns a filtered ResultSet where unit1_id is greater than unit2_id, indicating non-normalized conversions.

methods.name: transitive
methods.description: Returns a filtered ResultSet where the 'transitive' boolean is true.

methods.name: non_transitive
methods.description: Returns a filtered ResultSet where the 'transitive' boolean is false.
